hidden_risks: Electronic control board or touchscreen failure
Internal mechanical timing or needle bar wear
Missing embroidery hoops and power accessories
response.best_proof: A photo or video showing the machine powered on with the operational screen lit up and all included hoops visible.
seller_claims_unsupported: High-speed operation and stitch performance claims
response.failure_mode: Confusing a computerized embroidery machine with a standard sewing machine or assuming the item is brand new factory stock simply because it rests on a cardboard box.
